name: VUORSE-VORTEX Source Curation Overlay
description: Hand-audited manifest fields that a disk walk cannot re-derive. vuorse_vortex.indexing.build_source_manifest reads this file and joins it onto the walk, so regeneration adds new files and drops removed ones without reverting curated judgement.
keyed_by: repo-relative source path, exactly as it appears in source_manifest.json
precedence: canon_status declared by a source's own JSONL records outranks this overlay.
Otherwise this overlay outranks the ROUTES table default.
Curated notes replace generated notes; generated WARNINGS are always appended.
notes: Seeded 2026-09-05 from the hand-audited manifests/corpus/source_manifest.json, by diffing it against build_source_manifest(curation_path=None) so that only fields the walk cannot reproduce are recorded here.
Machine-generated notes ('N records', 'MIXED privacy posture: ...') are not seeded: the builder re-derives them on every run.

The note 'id collides with hooplehopper_totality/debriefing_walled.jsonl' is not seeded either. It was the swallowed collision report that T1 removed; the builder now disambiguates the id instead of narrating the collision.
An overlay entry whose path leaves the corpus is reported in ManifestReport.orphaned_curation, never dropped silently.
